selection.scope: P3 structural validation set, selected before new seventh-round scores; no new official evaluations performed
selection.component: heavy: largest GraphIR dependency component compute_work / total compute_work >= 0.5; distributed otherwise
selection.read_potential: old fifth-round-plan diagnostic repeated_tensors / compute_ops; high strictly above eligible-pool median, low at or below median
selection.quota_rule: Eight crossed strata: one sample per stratum, then one additional sample in the more populated read-potential half of each size/component pair; ties use lexical stratum order. This yields 3 per size/component pair and 12 total.
selection.sampling: Process strata in lexicographic order, sort eligible cases in each stratum by case ID, use Python random.Random(20260929).sample without replacement for the specified quota.

limitations: These graphs are excluded from the sixth-round P3 development and extension panels only; they were used in earlier historical searches and are not globally unseen test graphs.
Old read diagnostics describe one recorded five-core P3 plan per graph, not all possible plans. Repeated tensor density is a sampling proxy, not a bound or guarantee of cache benefit.
The 12 cases are deliberately balanced by structure rather than sampled proportionally to the 100-graph population; unweighted panel averages are not unbiased full-population performance estimates.

To preserve this validation distinction, do not tune the new controller using these outcomes and then report the same outcomes as untouched validation. Subsequent changes require a separately labelled retest or new sample.
